feed_rate_kg_d.owner: AQS-ASSAY-001 Rev C design feed rate (owner basis)

feed_case_A_silicate_oxide.owner: AQS-ASSAY-001 Rev C class A (regolith-like) point
feed_case_A_silicate_oxide.verification_test: XRF/XRD assay of a representative class A lot

case_A_oxide_fractions.verification_test: XRF major-oxide analysis of the accepted feed

case_A_leach_extent.verification_test: Bench leach of class A feed in HCl at 85 C, ICP-OES of liquor for Al, Ca, Mg, Fe extraction

acid_conc_design_wt.verification_test: Bench leach of class A feed at 20 wt% HCl, 90-108 C (CARLETON_HCL_2023 basis is 38 %); ICP-OES extraction vs time
acid_conc_design_wt.published: CARLETON_HCL_2023 38 % HCl; PERRY9_HCL azeotrope 20.2 wt% caps evaporative concentration

bmed_sec_kWh_per_kg_base.verification_test: EDBM pilot on the plant chloride brine: SEC and current efficiency at the design product concentration

bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.units: kWh per kg acid+base (current graph basis)
bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.verification_test: Superseded: BMED energy now from bmed_sec_kWh_per_kg_base (X-PAR acid-loop decision)
bmed_sec_design_kWh_per_kg_pair.published: EDBM_PILOT_2023 1.4-2.6 kWh/kg NaOH at 0.5-1 M; EDBM_WHEY_2021 6.7 kWh/kg at 2 M

ew_current_efficiency_design.verification_test: Bench chloride EW cell per metal: deposit mass vs charge (current efficiency)
ew_current_efficiency_design.published: USBM_CL_EW 0.85-0.90 chloride; SCHLESINGER2011 0.85-0.92 sulfate; lower bound taken (bounding current)

ew_cell_voltage_V.verification_test: Bench diaphragm chloride EW cell, cupric electrolyte, 200 A/m2: cell voltage and energy per kg Cu
ew_cell_voltage_V.basis: V = E_spec M CE / (z F) with E_spec 2.1 kWh/kg (cupric), CE 0.85, z 2: 2.12 V

cp_hcl20_kJ_kgK.verification_test: Check against the Perry sec. 2 aqueous HCl heat-capacity table at 20 wt% and 60 C

cp_naoh20_kJ_kgK.verification_test: Check against the Perry sec. 2 aqueous NaOH heat-capacity table at 20 wt% and 60 C

U_free_convection_W_m2K.verification_test: Coil outlet temperature on the installed air cooler

slurry_min_DN.verification_test: Deposition-velocity check of each slurry line at its solids loading (Durand/Wilson correlation) and a flow-loop trial with the plant solids

ew_bus_drop_V.verification_test: Measure bus-bar and contact drop on the installed DC bus at rated current

rect_efficiency.verification_test: Vendor efficiency curve for the selected rectifier at the operating current

mvr_kWh_per_t.verification_test: Vendor MVR quote at 0.8 t/d for 7 -> 20 wt% HCl and NaOH; small-unit penalty measured on the pilot
mvr_kWh_per_t.published: VOGELBUSCH_MVR 19-72; EVAPCRYST_MVR 30-60 for high BPE; upper bound taken

base_conc_design_wt.units: mass fraction NaOH on IA-BASE-01 and IA-BASE-PPT
base_conc_design_wt.verification_test: Bench hydroxide precipitation of class A leach liquor with 20 wt% NaOH; glass digest at 20 wt%
base_conc_design_wt.published: Matches the acid side; no azeotrope limit on NaOH-water

bmed_product_molarity.units: mol/L acid and base leaving BMED
bmed_product_molarity.verification_test: EDBM pilot on the plant chloride brine at 2 M product: SEC and current efficiency
bmed_product_molarity.published: EDBM_WHEY_2021 maximum 3.6 M acid / 3.0 M base; SEC 6.7 kWh/kg quoted at 2 M

pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.verification_test: PVsyst or measured site irradiance year at the chosen tilt

pv_system_derate.verification_test: PVsyst loss tree for the selected modules and inverters

storage_round_trip.verification_test: ZnBr2 vendor round-trip efficiency at the duty cycle

bus_power_factor.verification_test: Measured power factor on the 480 V bus

ppt_naoh_per_cl.units: mol NaOH per mol chloride precipitated as hydroxide
ppt_naoh_per_cl.basis: AlCl3 + 3 NaOH -> Al(OH)3 + 3 NaCl; MCl2 + 2 NaOH -> M(OH)2 + 2 NaCl
ppt_naoh_per_cl.verification_test: Bench hydroxide precipitation of class A leach liquor: NaOH consumed per mol chloride to the target pH; Ca retained in solution (Ca(OH)2 is sparingly soluble) measured by ICP-OES

digest_naoh_per_sio2.units: mol NaOH per mol SiO2 dissolved
digest_naoh_per_sio2.basis: SiO2 + 2 NaOH -> Na2SiO3 + H2O; dissolved mass = IA-GLASS-03 cullet in less S08G glass stock out, all taken as SiO2 (bounding)
digest_naoh_per_sio2.verification_test: Bench caustic digest of burned cullet: mass dissolved and NaOH consumed per kg cullet

naoh_makeup_form.units: mass fraction NaOH in purchased make-up (anhydrous flake)
naoh_makeup_form.verification_test: Supplier certificate for NaOH flake; dissolution into EVAP_BASE product checked on the pilot

pv_module_eff.verification_test: Module datasheet of the in-house cell line (SOLAR_PV_CELL) at STC

pv_roof_gcr.verification_test: Row-shading study (inter-row spacing at winter solstice noon) for the chosen tilt

pv_roof_yield_factor.verification_test: PVWatts run at the roof tilt and azimuth; replace 1.0 with the ratio

ext_light_frac.units: fraction of 24 h lit; occupant-sensor controlled storage/production hall (IECC 2021 C405.2.1)

ext_dT_mean_K.units: K mean |T_in - T_out|: (HDD65 + CDD65) x 5/9 / 365 with HDD65 2272 F-d and CDD65 2878 F-d (DFW 1991-2020 normals)
ext_dT_mean_K.verification_test: NOAA 1991-2020 normals for the final site; TMY3 bin-hour calculation

roof_pv_dead_kPa.units: kPa PV modules and ballasted racking

roof_snow_kPa.verification_test: ASCE 7 Hazard Tool ground snow load at the site

ext_conditioned.verification_test: Bin-hour load calculation on TMY3 for the hall programme

ext_U_wall.units: W/(m2 K) metal building wall U-0.094 Btu/h ft2 F, climate zone 3

ext_wall_h_mm.units: mm eave height of the extension (EXT_HALL block height)

evap_bp_acid_C.units: C boiling at 101.3 kPa, 20 wt% HCl (azeotrope temperature, bounding)
evap_bp_acid_C.verification_test: Boiling-point measurement on the product at the body pressure

evap_bp_base_C.units: C boiling at 101.3 kPa, 20 wt% NaOH (BPE 8 K from the Duhring lines)
evap_bp_base_C.verification_test: Read-off check on the Duhring chart and boiling-point measurement

evap_dT_drive_K.verification_test: Pilot run: compressor ratio vs heat flux

evap_U_ff.units: W/(m2 K) falling film, condensing steam outside

evap_U_ix.units: W/(m2 K) liquid-liquid interchanger (graphite block or nickel plate)

evap_cp_feed.units: kJ/(kg K) 2 M HCl or NaOH

evap_comp_eta.verification_test: Compressor map of the in-house blower

evap_motor_eta.verification_test: IEC 60034-30-1 class of the motor used

evap_wet_min.units: kg/(m s) minimum falling-film wetting rate

evap_body_design_kPag.units: kPa g body design (plus full vacuum)
evap_body_design_kPag.verification_test: Pressure test per ASME VIII-1 UG-99 / ISO 16528

evap_cond_hcl_wt.units: mass fraction HCl in the acid condensate (column top vapour)
evap_cond_hcl_wt.verification_test: Titrate the condensate on the pilot; must sit above the 0.0034 equilibrium over the 2 M feed (PERRY7_HCL_VLE)

evap_col_margin.units: packed height margin on ideal stages x HETP

evap_col_u_m_s.units: m/s superficial vapour velocity (below flooding for 25 mm rings at this load)
evap_col_u_m_s.verification_test: Flooding check with the selected packing C_s (sizing/scrubber.py)

pv_oversize_factor.units: PV nameplate / PV needed to close the daily balance
pv_oversize_factor.verification_test: NREL NSRDB TMY hourly run (PVWatts v8) for the site: fraction of days with yield below 1/factor of the mean; export tariff from the serving utility
pv_oversize_factor.published: Owner decision, Mike Matthews 2026-10-15 (D75): 200 % of plant requirement; storage still charges on a day at half the mean yield, surplus exported

pv_dc_ac_ratio.verification_test: Inverter clipping loss from the PVsyst/PVWatts hourly run at the chosen ratio
pv_dc_ac_ratio.published: NREL PVWatts v8 default DC to AC size ratio 1.2

vs_air_mg_kg.units: mg air per kg feed (N2 13.4 + O2 8.3 at 25 C, 101.3 kPa, air-saturated fresh water)
vs_air_mg_kg.verification_test: Vent gas flow meter on the column vent during commissioning

vs_T_C.verification_test: Vent condenser outlet temperature at design cooling water

vs_y_out_ppm.units: ppmv HCl at the scrubber outlet (half the ACGIH TLV-C 2 ppm)

vs_dp_mm.units: mm, nominal packing (in-house cut PVC tube rings)
vs_dp_mm.verification_test: Pressure drop and wetting test on the cut rings

vs_a_m2_m3.units: m2/m3 specific area of 16 mm rings

vs_mwr.units: m3/(m h) minimum wetting rate, packings below 75 mm

vs_naoh_excess.units: mol NaOH fed / mol HCl absorbed
vs_naoh_excess.verification_test: Sump pH above 12 at the bleed rate

vs_p_shell_case.units: design case: column bypassed, condensate at the body vapour composition (17.1 wt% HCl); normal case reported
vs_p_shell_case.verification_test: Condensate titration during start-up before the column profile forms
